community_list_entries.name: MemRiskBench: Trace-Aware Risk-Preserving Evaluation for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

phase1_classification.kind_reason: 120-episode scripted benchmark with deterministic trace checks for memory risks: R1 stale memory, R2 conflicting memory, R3 cross-scope/user leakage, R4 revoked memory reuse, R5 constraint decay; episodes, scoring code and traces released on GitHub.
